architectural_identity.section: Low western quiet canopy and cool low service ceiling contrast with tall social/arrival volume; substantial perimeter dado, visibly glazed middle and supported head.
architectural_identity.compatible_kit_reuse: Twenty exact fitting/allocation/rest matches use prior original port-forward profiles with rigid translation; no reflection/rescaling/rest template exchange. Private-court resolved kit translated; common room and receiving independently authored.
